source: It’s worth watching #8 Wade’s Dunk on Varejao and #10 Nate Robinson blocks Yao
why: In data/curated_merged_by_decade.csv the 2000s rows rank Wade dunks on Anderson Varejao 9th (4,938,565 views) and Nate Robinson blocks Yao Ming 11th (4,122,823), both one place lower than the story says (a play such as Shaq finger wags Mutumbo, Jordan scores 51 at age 38 or Derrick Rose crosses up Andre Miller, all between 4.9M and 6.0M views, must have been absent or ranked differently in the authors' snapshot). The stated ranks 8 and 10 cannot be reproduced from these files.

source: Kobe leads the 2010s, with 14 million views for his final NBA game. It’s only slightly higher than one of the most-viewed game-winners on YouTube: Curry’s last shot vs. Thunder on February 27, 2016, a regular season game!
